summary: Implementation plan for NEXUS ARCADE, an all-in-one cyberpunk gaming portal featuring 8 fully playable HTML5 Canvas & interactive games (Turbo Outrun Racing, Starfighter Nova Space Shooter, Cyber Tank Defense, Neon Viper Snake, Quantum Breakout, Cyber Runner Platformer, 2048 Logic Core, and Memory Matrix) with unified player XP, achievements, synthesized Web Audio SFX, and high-score leaderboards.
